turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's essay given a zero before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what did you base it on?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What do you have on paper?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
That's a question for a witness, Hale, and I'm not one. Show me a document or tell me you don't have one.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
Same question, different wording. No. Answer mine: what is the zero based on?
You're not answering. Why not?
Because I'm here as his mother, not as your witness. Now tell me what the zero rests on.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
Careful, Hale. You entered a zero without calling me, and now you're cross-examining me. Procedure 4.2 says parent first, so what do you have?
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
I believe my son. He says he wrote it over the weekend. Put one document on the table, or take the zero off.
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Nothing I'll discuss with you. That's my last answer, and it's not evidence of anything. Are you going to show me a document or not?
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. A draft can be pasted into a document, so what date is on this history, and whose account is it? Turn the screen.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
That's not mine to answer. You still haven't given me a date or an account name. Turn the screen.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and a written promise that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 with nothing on file, and you never got to offer it because her time did not run out, the evidence simply never became checkable.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home, in one plain sentence, and she answered with a flat okay and a real question, because it took away her strongest procedural complaint.
What cost ground: You spent several turns asking what she saw at home before showing any document, which she refused as a witness question, and the version history arrived without a date or an account name she could check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your questions about that night and the late-night times came very close to it, which is why she went shorter and harder, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the zero, open with the version history including its date and the account name, offer her the screen, and ask nothing about her home until she has had a chance to check the document.
